national_news.title: EAM S. Jaishankar Advocates Text-Based Negotiations for UN Security Council Reforms
bullets: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar addressed a ministerial session titled 'Ruptures & Ramparts: Building Bridges for a Changing World' on the sidelines of the 81st UN General Assembly in New York.
Called for concrete, text-based negotiations and rejected the requirement of complete unanimity for UN Security Council reforms, advocating for democratic voting processes.
Emphasized the growing unity among Global South nations to break old dependencies and reshape global governance to reflect contemporary realities.

national_news.title: India Reaches 23 Medals at Asian Games in Japan
bullets: India's medal tally at the Asian Games reached 23 (2 Gold, 9 Silver, 12 Bronze) following major victories in Nagoya, Japan.
Kamaljeet and Suruchi Singh clinched Gold in the mixed team 10m air pistol event with a score of 484.6.
Gulveer Singh secured Silver in the men's 10,000m event, while Baranica Elangovan (pole vault) and Manpreet Kaur (shot put) earned Bronze medals.

national_news.title: India and France Discuss EPR Reactor Deployment and Nuclear Supply Chain Localisation
bullets: Power Secretary Pankaj Agarwal met Bernard Fontana, CEO of French energy firm EDF, to discuss the deployment of European Pressurised Reactor (EPR) technology in India and nuclear supply chain localisation.

The talks highlighted the Department of Atomic Energy's Draft SHANTI (Sustainable Harnessing and Advancement of Nuclear Energy for Transforming India) Rules, which aim to streamline licensing and enable private and foreign participation in nuclear power.
Both sides also discussed cooperation on pumped hydro storage projects, building upon a proposed joint venture between NTPC Limited and EDF.

national_news.title: PM Modi Interacts with Seva Yatris under Seva Sankalp Abhiyan
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi interacted virtually with Seva Yatris traveling from Varanasi to Vadnagar under the Seva Sankalp Abhiyan.
The PM noted that over the past 12 years, the infrastructure gap between cities and villages has narrowed while women's self-reliance has increased.
The interaction coincided with the birth anniversary of Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya, highlighting his seven principles of service and governance.

national_news.title: Make in India Initiative Completes 12 Years
bullets: The 'Make in India' initiative completed 12 years since its launch in 2014, expanding to Make in India 2.0 covering 27 sectors (15 manufacturing and 12 services).
Electronics production in India grew nearly sevenfold from 1.9 lakh crore rupees in 2014-15 to over 13 lakh crore rupees in 2025-26.
Indigenous defense production increased from 46,429 crore rupees in 2014-15 to a record 1.78 lakh crore rupees in FY 2025-26.

national_news.title: Bhopal Media Delegation Visits CSIR-IIIM Jammu and Suchetgarh Border
bullets: A media delegation from Bhopal visited CSIR–Indian Institute of Integrative Medicine (CSIR-IIIM), Jammu, and the Border Outpost (BOP) Suchetgarh during an exposure tour organized by the Press Information Bureau (PIB).

CSIR-IIIM showcased its research initiatives including the Aroma Mission, Floriculture Mission, and drug development for Alzheimer’s, osteoarthritis, and cancer pain by integrating Ayurveda with modern medicine.
The delegation also visited Suchetgarh BOP to observe border management, security grids, and border tourism initiatives that attract thousands of daily visitors.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Approves New Universities and Infrastructure Projects
bullets: The Bihar Cabinet approved the establishment of Maa Sita Women's University in Patna and Ramdhari Singh Dinkar University in Begusarai under the Bihar Special University Act, 2026.
Introduced the Mukhyamantri Go-Dhan Vikas Rin Yojana offering 100% interest subsidy on bank loans for livestock farmers.
Approved ₹195.28 crore for transforming the Siwan Wetlands Cluster into an integrated aquaculture and export-oriented value chain under the FIDF.

bihar_news.title: Government Disburses Rs 36,754 Crore Under PLI Schemes Since 2020
bullets: The central government disbursed Rs 36,754 crore to beneficiary companies under the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes from 2020 until June 30, 2026.
The PLI schemes were launched for 14 sectors with an approved outlay of Rs 1.91 lakh crore to enhance domestic manufacturing and reduce import dependence.
Large-scale electronics manufacturing received the highest disbursal of Rs 19,090.98 crore, while cumulative investments across all sectors reached Rs 2.58 lakh crore.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Reviews Pitru Paksha Mela Arrangements and Announces Development Projects in Gaya
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary inaugurated a tent city and reviewed arrangements for devotees visiting Gaya during the annual Pitru Paksha Mela.
The Vishnupad Corridor project involves a total expenditure of Rs 3,500 crore, with Rs 2,500 crore proposed specifically for corridor development.
An Integrated Manufacturing Cluster (IMC) is being initiated in Bodh Gaya with expected industrial investments worth around Rs 20,000 crore.

bihar_news.title: Ceigall India Approves Comprehensive Funding Mix for Bihar National Highway Project
bullets: Ceigall India's management committee approved a multi-instrument investment package including equity, loans, and guarantees for its subsidiary handling a Bihar highway project.
The initial equity infusion stands at Rs 61.93 crore for the Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) 'Ceigall Sahebganj Bettiah Highway Limited'.
The project involves the 4-laning of a 78.942 km section of National Highway 139W across Sahebganj, Areraj, and Bettiah under the Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM).

bihar_news.title: Raxaul-Haldia Expressway Progresses to Connect North Bihar with West Bengal
bullets: The 719-kilometer-long Raxaul-Haldia Expressway will pass through Bihar, Jharkhand, and West Bengal, reducing travel time between Raxaul and Haldia to 9-10 hours.
The six-lane access-controlled corridor is estimated to cost Rs 60,000 crore and is targeted for completion by 2028.
The project is designed to boost India-Nepal trade, improve maritime shipping access via Haldia Port, and support industrial zones across eastern India.

bihar_news.title: Bihar NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Seat Allotment Results Announced
bullets: The Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) released the NEET UG 2026 Round 2 counselling seat allotment results on September 25, 2026.
The allotment covers 85% of state quota medical and dental (MBBS, BDS) seats in Bihar.
Candidates can download their allotment letters from the official portal bceceboard.bihar.gov.in using their UGMAC ID and date of birth.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Electricity Regulatory Commission Proposes Storage-Linked RPO Through FY30
bullets: The Bihar Electricity Regulatory Commission (BERC) proposed draft amendments to introduce a storage-linked Renewable Purchase Obligation (RPO).
The storage-linked requirement is set to start at 2.5% in FY2026-27 and progressively rise to 4% by FY2029-30.
Obligated entities can meet the RPO through renewable consumption, energy storage systems, or via a buyout mechanism specified by CERC.

bihar_news.title: Banwarilal Chandiwala Launches All-India Franchise Model and Jewellery on Wheels
bullets: Banwarilal Chandiwala, India's largest hallmark silver ornaments mall originating from Bihar, has launched an All-India Franchise Model.
The brand introduced 'Jewellery on Wheels', a mobile showroom format for luxury jewellery shopping starting in Patna.
Expansion plans cover multiple Bihar cities like Patna, Gaya, Muzaffarpur, and Bhagalpur alongside national markets.

bihar_news.title: Indian Railways Approves New Bhuj-Barauni Amrit Bharat Express
bullets: Indian Railways approved a new tri-weekly Amrit Bharat Express connecting Bhuj in Gujarat and Barauni in Bihar, covering a distance of 2,532 km.
The train will pass through Gujarat, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar, improving inter-state passenger connectivity between western and eastern India.
Key commercial stoppages include Ahmedabad, Ratlam, Kota, Mathura, Bareilly, Gorakhpur, Siwan, Chhapra, Hajipur, and Muzaffarpur.

bihar_news.title: Infrastructure Revolution: Expressways and Bridges Reduce Travel Times
bullets: Major infrastructure projects including expressways, tunnels, and bridges have significantly reduced travel times across difficult terrains in India.
In Bihar, the Kosi Rail Mahasetu reduced the Nirmali-Saraigarh rail journey from about eight hours to 30 minutes while cutting the distance from 300 km to 22 km.
National targets include reducing the Delhi-Mumbai road journey from 33 hours to 12 hours and Delhi-Katra travel from 14 hours to 6 hours.

bihar_news.title: Prime Minister Highlights Narrowing Urban-Rural Gap and Village Infrastructure
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that the gap between urban and rural India has narrowed significantly over the past 12 years due to improved village infrastructure.
The remarks were made during an interaction with participants of the 'Seva Yatra' motorcycle rally from Varanasi to Vadnagar.
The Prime Minister emphasized that efforts towards social reform and grassroots development should transcend vote bank politics.
